provenance.prior_familiarity: Primary reviewer knows v13 references, contexts and four masked Plug answers from prior tasks; OPERA role received only the masked context task. This is familiar development material, not blinded human or held-out evaluation.

rules: Complete requires all required facts including scope and relevant units in actual received text.
No numeric recomputation, magnitude-inferred units, invisible headers or source-page-wide assumptions.
Cross-span alignment is allowed only when actual matching rows and explicit year labels supply the mapping; record this inference explicitly.
Document identifiers and latest comparative years do not certify the annual-report fiscal year.
Do not infer complete support from same-page presence or from a prelisted sufficient-page set; all required evidence must occur in the actual received context.
No source text outside the received contexts was used to supply missing facts or units.
